parts.part_stem:
A simple transformer consists of two coils of wire wound on a soft-iron core, as illustrated in Fig. 9.1.

{{figure:9702_w20_41_q09_figure_9_1}}

There is a sinusoidal current in the primary coil.

Explain:
parts.text: how this current gives rise to an induced electromotive force (e.m.f.) in the secondary coil

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: why the e.m.f. induced in the secondary coil is not constant.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain why the soft-iron core in (b) is laminated.
